name: Volcanic Activity

faq.answer: Liv Rizzlefix is a contact stationed in the port town of Ratchet who needs samples of ash gathered from Un'Goro Crater.
The ash comes from the fire elementals that wander around the slopes of the central volcano in Un'Goro Crater.
faq.q: Where is the Un'Goro Ash found?

faq.answer: With her master Marvon Rivetseeker long gone, Liv Rizzlefix is starting experiments of her own and hopes the ash will teach her about the strange volcanic activity in Un'Goro Crater.
faq.q: Why does Liv Rizzlefix want the ash?

sections.body: Liv Rizzlefix in the port town of Ratchet seeks ash from deep within Un'Goro Crater. Fire elementals wander the slopes of the great volcano rising in the crater's center, burning with heat from the depths below. You are sent into the wild basin to face the living flames and secure samples of the ash they leave behind.
sections.title: Embers of the Crater

summary: Liv Rizzlefix in Ratchet needs volcanic ash collected from the fiery spirits prowling the center of Un'Goro Crater. The smoking peak holds living flames born of the deep earth, and bringing their remnants back safely is no easy feat.
